# Media list (`media-list`)

Songs, episodes and films: thumbnail, title, subtitle and meta, pressable rows.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMediaList` (types in `dist/web/data-display/mediaList.d.ts`): `ul.mh-media-list`: songs, episodes, films. Each `li.__item` holds a `__row` (`div`, or a `button` named "Play: Title, Subtitle, Meta" with `onSelect`): a square `__thumb` (themed `__placeholder` icon under a lazy `__image` that hides itself on error), `__text` (`__title` on one line, `__subtitle` "subtitle · meta") and an optional `__action` icon.

```ts
export function createMediaList(options: MediaListOptions): MediaListHandle;

export interface MediaListOptions {
  items: MediaListItem[];
  /** Accessible name of the list ("Search results", "Up next"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Placeholder icon when a row has no image (default `music`; `film` for video). */
  placeholder?: IconName | string;
  /** A trailing icon on every row (`play`), showing what selecting the row does. */
  action?: IconName | string;
  /** What the action does, the start of each row's accessible name ("Play"). */
  actionLabel?: string;
  /** Makes every row a button; called with the row's index. */
  onSelect?: (index: number) => void;
}

export interface MediaListHandle {
  el: HTMLUListElement;
  setItems(items: MediaListItem[]): void;
}

export interface MediaListItem {
  title: string;
  /** Artist, show, album or source. */
  subtitle?: string | null;
  /** Duration, year, episode ("3:42", "S2 E4"). Shown after the subtitle as "subtitle · meta". */
  meta?: string | null;
  /** Thumbnail URL; `null`, missing or failing to load shows the placeholder. */
  image?: string | null;
  /** Placeholder icon for this row (default: the list's `placeholder`). */
  placeholder?: IconName | string;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMediaList, createText, type MediaListItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const songs: MediaListItem[] = [
  { title: 'Lanterns on the Quay', subtitle: 'Mira Holloway', meta: '3:42' },
  { title: 'Slow Tide Radio', subtitle: 'The Fenwick Lamps', meta: '4:15' },
  { title: 'Paper Weather', subtitle: 'Juno Marsh', meta: '2:58' },
];

const playing = createText('Nothing playing', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const queue = createMediaList({
  label: 'Up next',
  items: songs,
  action: 'play',
  actionLabel: 'Play',
  onSelect: (i) => (playing.textContent = `Playing ${songs[i]!.title}`),
});

document.body.append(queue.el, playing);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MediaList, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { MediaListItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const songs: MediaListItem[] = [
  { title: 'Lanterns on the Quay', subtitle: 'Mira Holloway', meta: '3:42' },
  { title: 'Slow Tide Radio', subtitle: 'The Fenwick Lamps', meta: '4:15' },
  { title: 'Paper Weather', subtitle: 'Juno Marsh', meta: '2:58' },
];

export function MediaListExample() {
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState<MediaListItem | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <MediaList
        label="Up next"
        items={songs}
        action="play"
        actionLabel="Play"
        onSelect={(i) => setPlaying(songs[i] ?? null)}
      />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        {playing ? `Playing ${playing.title}` : 'Nothing playing'}
      </Text>
    </>
  );
}
```
